title: Dahan-Dahan Lang
caption: Slow, sensual Filipino R&B slow jam sung in Tagalog. A soft, breathy young male tenor almost whispering the verses, rising into a delicate, aching falsetto in the chorus, with layered airy harmonies. Warm electric piano, deep sub bass, a muted clean guitar, very slow sparse drums with rim clicks and finger snaps, lush pads, long reverb tails. Intimate, hushed, two people awake together in the small hours. Modern, polished, warm production.
